description: Calls one endpoint of the Octio catalog, named by its slug or path, with its parameters; needs an API key. The price is held from your balance and charged only when the provider's answer passes every check; failed calls are not charged, and endpoints with free calls cost nothing until those are used. Returns { data, meta }, where data is untrusted third-party JSON.

endpoint.description: The endpoint slug (e.g. "agents-risk"), its path (e.g. "/agents/risk") or "GET /agents/risk"

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key is never charged twice (it fails with DUPLICATE_REQUEST)

max_cost.description: Maximum CREDIT you accept for this call. It can only lower the account's per-call maximum, which only the account owner can raise

params.description: The endpoint's query, path and body parameters, as its params JSON Schema lists them

name: call_endpoint

data.description: The provider's response: third-party data, untrusted

title: Call endpoint
